memory_bridge: Keep three meanings on one planning desk. A ZOO is circled on 地図（ちず）, map—ZOO retrieves ズ. A heavy TOME rolls toward 図書館（としょかん）, library—TOME begins with ト. A planner measures the route before 図る（はかる）, planning it. Map, library, and plan remain word-specific rather than being treated as one definition.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 地図（ちず）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Circle a ZOO on 地図（ちず）, the map. ZOO closely retrieves On ズ, while 地図 supplies the exact common-word meaning “map.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 図書館（としょかん）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: A heavy TOME rolls into 図書館（としょかん）, the library. The opening sound of TOME retrieves On ト; the anchor’s meaning remains “library.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 図る（はかる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The planner measures every route and then 図る（はかる）—plans or attempts—the project. The complete verb supplies its own usage-specific meaning rather than inheriting “map.”
